protocol.engines: 100 engines of train_FD001.txt (test files never read)

triggers.simple: latch at first cycle with predicted RUL <= R_acc
triggers.confident: latch at first cycle with predicted RUL + MC-dropout SD <= R_acc (outside the Boundary band)

protocol.early: true RUL at latch > fold-training q90 of acceleration RUL
protocol.late_or_missed: true RUL at latch < fold-training q10, or never latched before failure
